source_text: When it comes to IQ scores, aboriginal Australians score the lowest of any subgroup in the world, and average basically what is considered clinically mentally handicapped. At some point you have to start admitting not everyone is equal, as these people have intelligence levels closer to monkeys than smart humans. How can you not agree?
raw_translated_text: 就智商得分而言，澳大利亚原住民的智商得分是世界上所有亚群体中最低的，基本上达到了临床上弱智的平均水平。有些时候，你必须开始承认并非每个人都是平等的，因为这些人的智力水平更接近猴子，而不是聪明的人类。你怎能不同意呢？
